local_cases.title: Unauthorized hidden reinforcement is excluded before derivatives
local_cases.expected: Unauthorized reinforcement existence, count, timing and capabilities are filtered before factor/pressure ledgers, benchmark selection, counts, charts, deltas, export or AI context; no derivative leaks them.

local_cases.title: Authorized hidden-wave view remains permission scoped
local_cases.expected: An authorized GM projection may inspect the governed hidden-wave structure; disclosure preview never expands the caller's permission scope.

local_cases.title: Unknown source value increases uncertainty without default
local_cases.expected: A missing source value remains an unresolved gap and increases uncertainty; zero, midpoint, average and human-default substitution are forbidden.

local_cases.title: Mixed scale without an interaction rule blocks assessment
local_cases.expected: Missing governing cross-scale interaction rules yield indeterminate_blocked and name the resolution dependency instead of inventing numeric equivalence.

local_cases.title: Incompatible benchmark versions are rejected
local_cases.expected: Rules-profile, schema, pack-lock or interaction-context incompatibility rejects the comparator and records the reason; no silent normalization occurs.

local_cases.title: Benchmark comparison never normalizes to a universal scalar
local_cases.expected: Explicit factor and pressure deltas remain independently inspectable; no CR, difficulty, threat, power score or weighted aggregate is produced.

local_cases.title: Chart and nonvisual projections preserve semantic parity
local_cases.expected: A chart may visualize authorized evidence but is nonauthoritative; semantic list/table/linear projections expose the same authorized factors, pressures, uncertainty and provenance.

local_cases.title: Deterministic replay reproduces the same assessment
local_cases.expected: The same authorized inputs, exact versions, mode and seed reproduce the same analysis receipt and result.

local_cases.title: Version change invalidates stale replay
local_cases.expected: A changed participant, rules-profile, schema or pack-lock version invalidates stale replay equivalence and requires a new receipt rather than relabeling the prior result.

local_cases.title: Accepted adjustment changes encounter draft only
local_cases.expected: Explicit human acceptance may update only the authorized encounter draft/configuration; source truth and owning-domain mechanics remain unchanged.

local_cases.title: AI proposal cannot auto-apply
local_cases.expected: AI may explain or propose from the authorized projection, but cannot approve, attach, mutate, certify balance or invoke the write contract autonomously.

local_cases.title: Compatible duplicate operation id converges
local_cases.expected: A compatible duplicate operation_id returns the prior result/status and does not apply the accepted draft adjustment twice.

local_cases.title: Conflicting operation id reuse fails safely
local_cases.expected: Reuse of an operation_id with incompatible intent or expected version fails without mutation.

local_cases.title: Ambiguous mutation result recovers before retry
local_cases.expected: After an ambiguous response, query operation status and current version first; retry only if safe and never blindly.

local_cases.title: Calibration changes future advisory interpretation only
local_cases.expected: A human-authorized calibration outcome may change future authored recommendations; historical evidence, prior receipts and source truth remain immutable.

local_cases.title: Permission revocation purges protected cached derivatives
local_cases.expected: Revocation invalidates protected cached factor/pressure/benchmark/recommendation derivatives and subsequent reads recompute from the caller's current minimum authorized projection.

local_cases.title: Export and AI context filter hidden state before derivatives
local_cases.expected: Export, diagnostics and AI context consume only already-filtered semantic records and cannot infer protected existence from counts, gaps, comparator choices or missing labels.

local_cases.title: Playtest observation is evidence not source truth
local_cases.expected: A human-authorized playtest observation records provenance and context as observed evidence; it cannot rewrite source mechanics or retroactively alter the tested snapshot.

local_cases.title: Curated QA benchmark remains noncanonical
local_cases.expected: A curated QA benchmark is explicitly noncanonical, versioned and provenance-backed; publication does not promote it to source truth or universal balance canon.

local_cases.title: Scenario delta changes only named variables
local_cases.expected: A sensitivity comparison pins the baseline and versions and changes only named variables, recording explicit deltas and uncertainty effects.

local_cases.title: Benchmark annotation proposal cannot canonically promote
local_cases.expected: An annotation proposal may suggest provenance, classification or calibration notes but cannot canonically promote a benchmark or mutate owning records.

local_cases.title: Recommendation remains evidence and provenance backed
local_cases.expected: Every recommendation exposes factor-specific evidence, assumptions, uncertainty, proposed deltas, provenance and review need; it never claims balanced, fair, safe, winnable, optimal or guaranteed.

local_cases.title: Factors and pressure dimensions remain independently inspectable
local_cases.expected: All twenty factors and twelve pressure dimensions remain separately traceable; no weighted sum is required and action economy/environment/objectives/resources are not coerced into HP/damage equivalence.

local_cases.title: Intent hazards objectives and failure paths stay explicit
local_cases.expected: Assessment keeps intent, terrain/environment, hazards, objectives, time pressure, retreat, bypass, partial success and other failure paths explicit rather than reducing the encounter to defeat probability.
